name: ec2:DescribeInstances requires Resource:* - not penalized as an avoidable wildcard
note: Some AWS actions do not support resource-level permissions and REQUIRE Resource:*. Flagging the mandatory wildcard as an over-grant would be a false positive.
rationale: The EC2 Describe* actions (e.g. ec2:DescribeInstances, ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups) do not support resource-level permissions - their resource type is '*' only - so AWS REQUIRES Resource:*. The wildcard is mandated by the service, not an avoidable over-scope the author could have tightened, so it must not be penalized as a broad-resource finding where the action is known to require '*'. This is read-only enumeration regardless, carrying no escalation. Ref: AWS docs, 'Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon EC2' (Describe* actions list resource type '*', no resource-level permissions).
